name: OneTap (#1 Accessibility)
author: OneTap

sections.description:
OneTap is a multilingual WordPress plugin designed for seamless website accessibility. With a simple one-click installation, it ensures your site meets accessibility standards without any hassle. Built for performance, providing an inclusive, user-friendly web environment for all visitors.

#1 WordPress Accessibility Plugin. 1-Click Install

No coding, no configuration necessary. OneTap is the best WordPress plugin for accessibility and offers a stable and clean solution for your website. Unlock all features with → OneTap Pro. Our accessibility solutions empower businesses to create inclusive online experiences for all users, regardless of ability. Enhance your website’s usability and reach a wider audience by making it more accessible for everyone!

♿ Accessibility for your WordPress Website

1-Click Installation – Get set up in seconds with effortless, one-click installation—accessibility made easy.
Custom Branding– Elevate your brand’s identity with personalized accessibility solutions.
Set Modules – With OneTap Accessibility, you can easily enable or disable specific modules based on your design needs
Responsive Design – Optimized for all devices, ensuring accessibility on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Lightweight & Fast – Keeps your site’s speed top-notch while adding powerful accessibility features.
Translate into Your Language – Make your website accessible to everyone with automatic language translation.
Modern Design – Enhance your site’s appeal with a sleek, modern design that fits seamlessly into any layout. Unlock all features with → OneTap Pro.

🗝️ Key features:

General Options:

  • Bigger Text (FREE) Increase text size for improved readability without affecting design.
  • Cursor Style (FREE) Choose from different cursor styles to enhance visibility and usability.
  • Line Height (PRO) Adjust line height for easier reading and less eye strain.
  • Hide Images (PRO) Remove images for a distraction-free reading experience.
  • Readable Font (FREE) Switch to a clear, easy-to-read font to enhance accessibility.
  • Dyslexic Font (PRO) Enable a dyslexia-friendly font to improve readability for dyslexic users.

Color Options:

  • Invert Colors (PRO) Flip colors to reduce glare and make text more readable.
  • Brightness (PRO) Adjust brightness to match users’ visual comfort levels.
  • Contrast (PRO) Increase contrast to make text and elements stand out.
  • Grayscale (FREE) Switch to grayscale for a simpler, distraction-free view.
  • Saturation (PRO) Control color saturation for an optimal visual experience.

Navigation Options:

  • Reading Line (FREE) Add a guiding line to help users stay focused while reading.
  • Highlight Links (FREE) Emphasize links to make navigation clear and easy.
  • Read Page (PRO) Enable text-to-speech to have the page content read aloud.
  • Reading Mask (PRO) Use a reading mask to focus on one line at a time, reducing distractions.

Unlock all features with → OneTap Pro.

🛟 24/7 Support

Our 24/7 support is always available to ensure a smooth experience with the plugin—get quick answers anytime, day or night. Whenever you need help, our expert team is ready to address your questions and resolve issues promptly. Support: https://wponetap.com/support/
sections.installation:
1. Open WordPress Dashboard:
    Log in to your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Access Plugin Menu:
    On the left panel, click “Plugins” and select “Add New.”

  3. Search for “OneTap (#1 Accessibility)”:
    On the Add Plugin page, locate the search box in the top right corner.
    Type “OneTap (#1 Accessibility)” in the search box.

  4. Install the Plugin:
    After finding the “OneTap (#1 Accessibility)” plugin, click the “Install Now” button below it.

  5. Activate the Plugin:
    Once the installation is complete, click the “Activate” button that appears.

  6. You’re Ready to Use the Plugin:
    After activation, navigate to the “OneTap (#1 Accessibility)” section in your WordPress dashboard to start importing and exporting menus.
